rule.text: value = p95 leak distance of the primary-source hand points, rounded up to 1 mm, capped at 15 mm; applied to panda_hand only; fingers join (own p95, same cap) only if their p95 < median over calls of the nearest target-to-finger distance
rule.recorded_with: AG3S.trajopt.experiments.panda_sfhand_leak on the sl15-DREC run (code of branch wip/sl15-sfhand); decision_by_source added by add_alternatives() from the same numbers
